messages:
priya_csm: kicking off Cerulean onboarding thread. Goal: pilot Redwood Hosted for chat assistant, evaluate Dedicated only if latency/cost tradeoffs demand. Proposed meetup: Mon 10/7 9am PT. Top agenda: stakeholder intros, success metrics, data paths, SSO/auth, pilot traffic plan, risks. Who9s in?

ethan_csm: I9ll run enablement + user-facing docs. 9am PT works for us.

cerulean_pm: PM + infra lead can make it. We9ll bring a sanitized sample (NDJSON) and a list of top 8 prompts.

noa_se: I9ll take integration + API keys. Need sample + test user credentials. Also want to confirm retention policy for logs.

rachel_eng: I can scope Dedicated fallback sizing and help define smoke tests for p50/p95. Will post bench template.

sam_successops: Proposed success criteria short list:
- Core flows pass end-to-end in staging (happy path + 3 edge cases)
- Stakeholder demo accepted by PM + CS lead
- Latency target: p50 < 350ms for typical prompt length
- Documented rollback & throttling policy
- 1st-week incident playbook + owner assigned

priya_csm: timeline suggestion:
Week A: Kickoff, access granted, sample uploaded
Week B: Integration + staging validation, enablement session 1
Week C: Pilot (low traffic) + feedback capture
Week D: Demo + go/no-go decision

cerulean_pm: legal wants a short note on data retention before Week B. We can provide a policy doc.

noa_se: noted 90legal contact9. Also request: Cerulean provide IP ranges for allowlist and a service account for uploads.

rachel_eng: For Dedicated bench I9ll run experiments on two configs and share results in the kickoff doc by Wed.

sam_successops: Feedback plan: 3-question pulse after pilot + 20-min stakeholder interview. Will draft.

priya_csm: Action checklist from thread:
- ethan_csm: create kickoff doc + send invite (owner)
- cerulean_pm: upload sanitized sample + prompts + legal contact (owner)
- noa_se: SSO & API checklist + test creds request (owner)
- rachel_eng: Dedicated bench + smoke test template (owner)
- sam_successops: success criteria + feedback survey (owner)
- priya_csm: schedule recurring 30/60 health checks & add risk flags (owner)

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Mon Oct 7 9:00am PT 50min 5"Cerulean: Redwood Onboard - First Touch". Link: https://meet.redwood/cerulean-kickoff

ethan_csm: I9ve added a skeleton agenda & pre-reads to the invite. Please populate before meeting.

cerulean_pm: uploading sample now, will confirm legal contact in thread.

noa_se: infra note: allowlist changes require 48h lead. Adding to calendar invite.

priya_csm: Great. If procurement or legal windows look tight, flag here ASAP so we can adjust pilot timing. See you Mon.
